These are the places in the patient chart app that call `createGlobalStore`, so a behaviour change would affect them. I took the line ranges from a single search for the name and didn't open the files, so the end lines are approximate.

1. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/store/patient-chart-store.ts`** creates the shared `patientChartStore` (line 19). It also imports `useStoreWithActions`, so any hooks and actions built on this store depend on the same behaviour.
2. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/store.ts`** creates `orderBasketStore` under the name `'order-basket'` (line 24). The order basket is shared across the app, so this is probably the widest-reaching use.
3. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/fe-wrapper/fe-wrapper.component.ts`** creates a module-level store named `'ampath-form-state'` (line 35).
4. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts`** defines a mock `createGlobalStore` (line 12). If the real signature or semantics change, this mock would need to change too.

I only searched for direct calls to `createGlobalStore`. Code that reads these stores indirectly, for example through `getGlobalStore` or the store hooks, isn't listed.
